title: hussaini jari ko ho dilbar mubarak
body:
hussaini jari ko ho dilbar mubarak
mubarak mubarak ho sarwar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
mubarak shabeehe ali ye pisar hai
mubarak ho moula ye dilbar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aabid hai zahid saqi aur saabir
hai mazloomo bekas ye rehbar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hue aaj sajjad muztar tawallud
hua ghar ali ka munawwar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
mubarak mubarak ho zahra o hyder
tumhe aaj dilbar ka dilbar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat me baqshaane waala tumhara
ab aaya ghulaamane hyder mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ye naayab tumhara hai moula hamara
ye choutha qaleefa payambar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hua noore abid se roushan zamana
hua qaana e dil munawwar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ali naam iska hai abid laqab hai
ye farzand qushroo o qushtar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
maqasid bar aaye mataalib bar aaye
kare jashn sabko ye daawar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
padho aj salwaat qamush kyu ho
kaho aaj moula ye dilbar mubarak
